title: Relative Bias Under Imperfect Identification in Observational Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2507.23743v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: To conduct causal inference in observational settings, researchers must rely on certain identifying assumptions. In practice, these assumptions are unlikely to hold exactly. This paper considers the bias of selection-on-observables, instrumental variables, and proximal inference estimates under violations of their identifying assumptions. We develop bias expressions for IV and proximal inference that show how violations of their respective assumptions are amplified by any unmeasured confounding in the outcome variable. We propose a set of sensitivity tools that quantify the sensitivity of different identification strategies, and an augmented bias contour plot visualizes the relationship between these strategies. We argue that the act of choosing an identification strategy implicitly expresses a belief about the degree of violations that must be present in alternative identification strategies. translated_title: 观察性因果推断中不完全识别下的相对偏差
translated_abstract: 在观察性研究环境中进行因果推断时，研究者必须依赖某些识别假设。而在实际应用中，这些假设很难完全成立。本文研究了当识别假设被违背时，基于可观测变量选择、工具变量以及近端推断的估计方法所产生的偏差。我们为工具变量和近端推断推导出了偏差表达式，这些表达式表明各识别假设的违背程度会如何被结果变量中任何未测量的混杂因素所放大。我们提出了一组敏感性分析工具，用于量化不同识别策略的敏感性，并通过一种增强的偏差等高线图来可视化这些策略之间的关系。我们认为，选择某种识别策略这一行为本身，就隐含地表达了研究者对其他备选识别策略中必然存在多大程度违背的一种信念判断。即使研究者有意共同……
tldr: 本文推导了观察性因果推断中工具变量和近端推断在识别假设被违背时的偏差表达式，揭示其会被未测量混杂放大，并提出敏感性分析工具和增强偏差等高线图来比较不同识别策略的相对偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper derives bias expressions for IV and proximal inference under violations of their identifying assumptions, showing how such violations are amplified by unmeasured confounding, and proposes sensitivity tools and an augmented bias contour plot to compare the relative bias across identification strategies.
